USEFUL INFORMATION Warning signs of a STROKE: The following can help you recognise if someone is having a stroke and ACT FAST if you see any of them. F – FACE: Ask the person to smile-does one side droop? A – ARMS: Ask the person to raise both arms and keep them there. S – SPEECH: Can the person repeat a sentence? Is their speech slurred? T – TIME: If you see any of the above signs – even just one – call 999 for an ambulance ///////////////////////////////////////////////// Suicidal Thoughts?
